title: Portfolio v2.0.0 — Visual Redesign Spec
scope: Visual redesign of personal portfolio from v1 to v2.0.0. Merges a pre-built Claude Design component system into an existing Next.js 14 App Router codebase. Covers stack migration (NextUI→HeroUI, Spline removal), i18n refactor (portfolio-data.js → locale JSON), JSX→TSX conversion, and 9 implementation phases.
